"""Derive per-group detection counts (n_WT, n_M) from the TopPICR expression matrix.

The toppicr-py skill's shortlist tool expects an occupancy table indexed by
featureId with columns n_<group>. The pipeline does not emit one, so this
script derives it directly from expression.csv (value > 0 == detected) and
joins the feature metadata needed for tier inspection.

Provenance: expression.csv and features.csv come from
toppic_run.py --output-dir analysis/differential-m-vs-wt (same directory).
"""

import re

import pandas as pd

expr = pd.read_csv("expression.csv", index_col=0)
feat = pd.read_csv("features.csv", index_col=0)

groups = {
    "WT": [c for c in expr.columns if re.search(r"WT0[1-5]", c)],
    "M": [c for c in expr.columns if re.search(r"M0[1-5]", c)],
}
assert len(groups["WT"]) == 5 and len(groups["M"]) == 5, groups

occ = pd.DataFrame(index=expr.index)
for name, cols in groups.items():
    occ[f"n_{name}"] = (expr[cols] > 0).sum(axis=1)
occ["n_total"] = (expr > 0).sum(axis=1)

meta_cols = [
    "gene", "proteoform", "uniprot_acc", "mass", "rt", "spectral_count",
    "n_unexpected_mods", "proteoform_level", "collision",
    "first_aa", "last_aa", "prot_length", "ann_type",
]
occ = occ.join(feat[[c for c in meta_cols if c in feat.columns]])
occ.index.name = "featureId"
occ.to_csv("features_with_occupancy.csv")
print(f"wrote features_with_occupancy.csv: {occ.shape[0]} features x {occ.shape[1]} cols")
print(occ[["n_WT", "n_M"]].value_counts().sort_index().to_string())

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["pandas"]
# ///
"""Quantitative summary of the WT vs M comparison (soybean nodule top-down).

Inputs (all in this directory, produced by toppicr-py):
  expression.csv, features.csv           -- toppic_run.py build
  comparison_WT_vs_M_full.json           -- toppic_plot.py compare --top 5000
  features_with_occupancy.csv            -- build_occupancy.py
  tiers.csv, gene_concordance.csv        -- toppic_shortlist.py

Writes: summary.json, sample_detection.csv, presence_only.csv,
shift_families.csv, shift_feature_rows.csv, top_effect_all_tiers.csv
"""

import json
import re

import pandas as pd

CMP = "comparison_WT_vs_M_full.json"
cmp = json.load(open(CMP))
cand = pd.DataFrame(cmp["candidates"]).set_index("featureId")
expr = pd.read_csv("expression.csv", index_col=0)
feat = pd.read_csv("features.csv", index_col=0)
occ = pd.read_csv("features_with_occupancy.csv", index_col=0)
tiers = pd.read_csv("tiers.csv", index_col=0)

wt = [c for c in expr.columns if re.search(r"WT0[1-5]", c)]
mut = [c for c in expr.columns if re.search(r"M0[1-5]", c)]

out = {}
out["design"] = {
    "groupA_WT": wt, "groupB_M": mut,
    "n_features_matrix": int(expr.shape[0]),
    "tested": cmp["testedCount"], "eligible": cmp["eligibleFeatureCount"],
    "bh_significant": cmp["bhSignificantCount"],
    "up_in_M": cmp["enrichedInGroupB"], "up_in_WT": cmp["enrichedInGroupA"],
    "method": cmp["method"], "definitions": cmp["definitions"],
}

# --- per-sample detection -------------------------------------------------
det = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample": expr.columns,
    "group": ["M" if re.search(r"M0[1-5]", c) else "WT" for c in expr.columns],
    "features_detected": [(expr[c] > 0).sum() for c in expr.columns],
    "total_intensity": [expr[c].sum() for c in expr.columns],
    "median_positive_intensity": [expr.loc[expr[c] > 0, c].median() for c in expr.columns],
})
det.to_csv("sample_detection.csv", index=False)
out["sample_detection"] = det.to_dict("records")

# --- presence-only (untested) features ------------------------------------
pres = occ[(occ["n_WT"] == 0) | (occ["n_M"] == 0)].copy()
pres["side"] = ["only_M" if r.n_M > 0 else "only_WT" for r in pres.itertuples()]
pres["all_in_group"] = [
    "both groups have >=1" if (r.n_WT > 0 and r.n_M > 0) else
    ("M only" if r.n_M > 0 else "WT only") for r in pres.itertuples()
]
pres_out = pres[pres["all_in_group"] != "both groups have >=1"].copy()
pres_out.sort_values("spectral_count", ascending=False).to_csv("presence_only.csv")
summary_pres = {
    "only_M": int((pres_out["all_in_group"] == "M only").sum()),
    "only_WT": int((pres_out["all_in_group"] == "WT only").sum()),
    "n_genes_only_M": int(pres_out.loc[pres_out["all_in_group"] == "M only", "gene"].nunique()),
    "n_genes_only_WT": int(pres_out.loc[pres_out["all_in_group"] == "WT only", "gene"].nunique()),
    "max_spectral_count_only_M": int(pres_out.loc[pres_out["all_in_group"] == "M only", "spectral_count"].max()),
    "max_spectral_count_only_WT": int(pres_out.loc[pres_out["all_in_group"] == "WT only", "spectral_count"].max()),
}

# features detected in >=1 sample of each group but not testable (<2 per group)
sub = occ[(occ.n_WT >= 1) & (occ.n_M >= 1) & ((occ.n_WT < 2) | (occ.n_M < 2))]
summary_pres["partial_both_groups_untested"] = int(len(sub))

out["presence_only"] = summary_pres

# --- unnamed numeric shifts ----------------------------------------------
SHIFT = re.compile(r"\[([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\]")


def shifts(s):
    return [float(x) for x in SHIFT.findall(str(s))]


rows = []
for fid, r in feat.iterrows():
    vals = shifts(r.get("proteoform", ""))
    if not vals:
        continue
    for v in vals:
        rows.append({
            "featureId": fid, "shift": v, "shift_key": f"{v:+.2f}",
            "gene": r.get("gene"), "uniprot_acc": r.get("uniprot_acc"),
            "n_unexpected_mods": r.get("n_unexpected_mods"),
        })
sh = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# attach statistics where the feature was tested
stat_cols = ["log2FoldChange", "bhFdr", "pValue", "spectralCount"]
sh = sh.merge(cand[stat_cols], left_on="featureId", right_index=True, how="left")
sh = sh.merge(occ[["n_WT", "n_M"]], left_on="featureId", right_index=True, how="left")
sh = sh.merge(tiers[["tier"]], left_on="featureId", right_index=True, how="left")
sh["significant"] = (sh["bhFdr"] < 0.05) & (sh["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1)
sh["direction"] = [
    "up in M" if (pd.notna(fc) and fc > 1) else ("up in WT" if (pd.notna(fc) and fc < -1) else "n.s./untested")
    for fc in sh["log2FoldChange"]
]
sh.to_csv("shift_feature_rows.csv", index=False)

fam = (sh.groupby("shift_key")
         .agg(n_features=("featureId", "nunique"),
              n_genes=("gene", "nunique"),
              n_sig=("significant", "sum"),
              n_up_M=("direction", lambda s: (s == "up in M").sum()),
              n_up_WT=("direction", lambda s: (s == "up in WT").sum()),
              max_abs_fc=("log2FoldChange", lambda s: s.abs().max()),
              total_spectral=("spectralCount", "sum"),
              genes=("gene", lambda s: ";".join(sorted(set(map(str, s.dropna()))))[:160]))
         .sort_values(["n_features", "n_genes"], ascending=False))
fam.to_csv("shift_families.csv")

# complement analysis: does +v pair with -v (or with -v + constant)?
vals = sorted(sh["shift"].unique())
comps = []
for v in vals:
    if v <= 0:
        continue
    exact = any(abs(x + v) < 0.01 for x in vals)
    near = sorted([x for x in vals if x < 0], key=lambda x: abs(x + v))[:2]
    comps.append({"shift": v, "n_features": int((sh.shift == v).sum()),
                  "exact_complement": exact,
                  "nearest_negative": near})
out["shift_complements"] = comps

out["shift_families_top"] = fam.head(15).reset_index().to_dict("records")
out["shift_overview"] = {
    "features_with_numeric_shift": int(sh["featureId"].nunique()),
    "distinct_shift_values": int(sh["shift"].nunique()),
    "families_recurring_multi_protein": int(((fam.n_genes >= 2) & (fam.n_features >= 2)).sum()),
    "features_with_shift_and_sig": int(sh.loc[sh.significant, "featureId"].nunique()),
}

# --- effect-size view across ALL tiers -----------------------------------
top = cand.copy()
top["abs_log2FC"] = top["log2FoldChange"].abs()
top = top.join(occ[["n_WT", "n_M"]])
top = top.join(tiers[["tier"]])
top = top.join(feat[["proteoform", "n_unexpected_mods", "proteoform_level", "mass"]])
top.sort_values("abs_log2FC", ascending=False).head(60).to_csv("top_effect_all_tiers.csv")
out["top_effect_head"] = top.sort_values("abs_log2FC", ascending=False).head(15)[
    ["gene", "log2FoldChange", "bhFdr", "n_WT", "n_M", "tier", "spectralCount",
     "n_unexpected_mods"]].reset_index().to_dict("records")

# --- tier composition ----------------------------------------------------
tc = (tiers.groupby(["tier", "direction"]).size().rename("n").reset_index())
tc.to_csv("tier_direction_counts.csv", index=False)
out["tier_direction"] = tc.to_dict("records")

# --- gene-level concentration -------------------------------------------
sig = tiers[tiers["significant"] == True] if "significant" in tiers.columns else tiers
gene = (tiers.groupby("gene")
        .agg(n_sig=("tier", "size"),
             n_up_M=("direction", lambda s: (s == "up in M").sum()),
             n_up_WT=("direction", lambda s: (s == "up in WT").sum()),
             med_fc=("log2FoldChange", "median"),
             max_abs_fc=("log2FoldChange", lambda s: s.abs().max()))
        .sort_values("n_sig", ascending=False))
gene.to_csv("gene_significant_counts.csv")
out["top_genes"] = gene.head(12).reset_index().to_dict("records")
out["tiers_columns"] = list(tiers.columns)
out["n_genes_with_sig"] = int(gene.shape[0])

json.dump(out, open("summary.json", "w"), indent=1, default=str)
print(json.dumps({k: out[k] for k in
                  ["sample_detection", "presence_only", "shift_overview",
                   "top_effect_head", "top_genes"]}, indent=1, default=str)[:6000])

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"

# ///
"""Collect source-linked PrSM rows for the two shift-family proteins.

Uses the shipped toppic-suite reader (prsm_read.py) per file, keeps rows with an
unexpected shift, and writes one CSV superset of the TopPIC column names for
prsm_inventory.py. Prints the best spectrum per protein and the mass levels.
"""

import csv
import glob
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ASSETS = Path(__import__("os").environ["TDEASE_SYSTEM_ASSETS"])
READER = ASSETS / "skills/toppic-suite/scripts/prsm_read.py"
PROTEINS = ["Q2KMJ4", "C6T4V4"]
RUN = Path("../../..")  # runs/soybean-all

rows = []
for f in sorted(RUN.glob("*_ms2_toppic_prsm.tsv")):
    sample = f.name.split("_ms2_toppic_prsm.tsv")[0]
    for prot in PROTEINS:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["uv", "run", "--script", str(READER), "rows", "--path", str(f),
             "--protein", prot, "--with-unexpected", "--max-evalue", "0.05",
             "--limit", "500"],
            capture_output=True, text=True)
        if out.returncode != 0:
            print("reader failed", f, out.stderr[:300], file=sys.stderr)
            continue

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["pandas"]
# ///
"""Inventory every unexpected-modification shift in the soybean nodule PrSM tables.

Source: runs/soybean-all/*_ms2_toppic_prsm.tsv (all 10 samples). Each row is a
PrSM; the `Unexpected modifications` column carries the residual(s) as
`+317.3901:[1-12]` = signed mass : span in the reported proteoform's own
1-based numbering. Terminal form and backbone come from the same row.

Outputs (analysis/shift-families/):
  shift_rows.csv   one row per (PrSM, shift) with value, span, support fields
  shift_families.csv  clustered families (0.05 Da) with recurrence and spans
"""

import csv
import glob
import re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

OUT = Path(".")
SHIFT_RE = re.compile(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?):\[(\d+)-(\d+)\]")
NAMED = re.compile(r"\[([A-Za-z][^\]]*)\]")

rows = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob("../../*_ms2_toppic_prsm.tsv")):
    sample = Path(path).name.split("_19Nov21")[0].replace("Glyco_SoybeanNodule_TPD_", "")
    txt = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    start = [i for i, l in enumerate(txt) if l.startswith("Data file name")][0]
    for r in csv.DictReader(txt[start:], delimiter="\t"):
        unexp = (r.get("Unexpected modifications") or "").strip()
        if not unexp or not SHIFT_RE.search(unexp):
            continue
        prot = r.get("Proteoform") or ""
        acc = (r.get("Protein accession") or "").split("|")
        acc = acc[1] if len(acc) > 1 else (acc[0] if acc else "")
        base = {
            "sample": sample,
            "scan": r.get("Scan(s)"),
            "prsm": r.get("Prsm ID"),
            "accession": acc,
            "first_aa": r.get("First residue"),
            "last_aa": r.get("Last residue"),
            "nterm_form": r.get("Protein N-terminal form"),
            "prot_mass": float(r.get("Proteoform mass") or 0),
            "precursor_mass": float(r.get("Precursor mass") or 0),
            "adjusted": float(r.get("Adjusted precursor mass") or 0),
            "charge": r.get("Charge"),
            "rt": r.get("Retention time"),
            "fragments": int(float(r.get("# Matched fragments") or 0)),
            "masses": int(float(r.get("# Matched masses") or 0)),
            "evalue": float(r.get("E-value") or 1),
            "prot_q": float(r.get("Proteoform-level Q-value") or 1),
            "unexpected": unexp,
            "proteoform": prot,
        }
        for v, a, b in SHIFT_RE.findall(unexp):
            rows.append({**base, "shift": float(v), "span_start": int(a), "span_end": int(b)})

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["prot_len"] = [len(NAMED.sub("", p).replace("(", "").replace(")", ""))
                  for p in df["proteoform"]]
df["span_is_nt"] = df["span_start"] == 1
df.to_csv(OUT / "shift_rows.csv", index=False)
print(f"{len(df)} shift rows from {df.prsm.nunique()} PrSMs, "
      f"{df.accession.nunique()} proteins, {df['shift'].nunique()} distinct values")

# cluster at 0.05 Da
centers, fam = [], []
for v in sorted(df["shift"].unique()):

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Test arithmetic hypotheses for the protein-restricted residuals.

Uses kernel residue masses (tdeasenexus-toolbox unimod-residues) only; the
combinatorics here are bookkeeping, not chemistry.

Hypotheses:
  A. the residual equals a sum of 1-4 residue masses (unmodeled sequence)
  B. the residual equals a 1-3 residue peptide (residues + H2O)
  C. the residual equals a small number of common biological groups
     (oxidation, methylation, acetyl, myristoyl, palmitoyl, ...) from UniMod
"""

import itertools
import json

res = json.load(open("residues.json"))["result"]["aminoAcids"]
mono = {}
for a in res:
    name = a.get("code") or a.get("residue") or a.get("letter")
    m = a.get("monoMass") or a.get("monoisotopicMass") or a.get("mass")
    if name and m:
        mono[name] = float(m)
print("residues:", len(mono), "example:", list(mono.items())[:3])

WATER = 18.0105646  # monoisotopic H2O
targets = {
    "317.3906 (EKN / 100527608 N-term)": 317.3906,
    "-231.0743 (blr7436 and 2 others)": -231.0743,
}

for label, target in targets.items():
    print("\n==", label)
    t = abs(target)
    tol = 0.02
    best = []
    letters = list(mono)
    for n in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        for combo in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(letters, n):
            s = sum(mono[c] for c in combo)
            if abs(s - t) <= tol:
                best.append((abs(s - t), "".join(combo), s - t))
            if abs(s + WATER - t) <= tol:
                best.append((abs(s + WATER - t), "".join(combo) + "+H2O", s + WATER - t))
    best.sort()
    for err, name, signed in best[:8]:
        print(f"   residues {name:12s} signed error {signed:+.4f} Da")
    if not best:
        print("   no 1-4 residue (or peptide) sum within 0.02 Da")

"""Inventory every source PrSM row for the +317 Da family (EKN / 100527608).

Reads the ten *_ms2_toppic_proteoform.tsv tables (TopPIC 1.8.0, 15 ppm,
3.2 Da proteoform tolerance, FDR 0.01, 1 unexpected shift +-500 Da) and keeps
rows of Q2KMJ4 (EKN) and C6T4V4 (100527608), then separates the +317 family
from the neighbouring residuals on the same proteins.
"""

import csv
import glob
import re

import pandas as pd

ACC = {"Q2KMJ4": "EKN", "C6T4V4": "100527608"}
rows = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob("*_ms2_toppic_proteoform.tsv")):
    lines = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    start = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("Data file name"))
    for row in csv.DictReader(lines[start:], delimiter="\t"):
        acc = row["Protein accession"].split("|")[1] if "|" in row["Protein accession"] else row["Protein accession"]
        if acc not in ACC:
            continue
        unexp = row["Unexpected modifications"] or ""
        m = re.match(r"([+-]\d+\.?\d*):\[(\d+)-(\d+)\]", unexp)
        rows.append({
            "sample": path.split("_ms2_toppic_proteoform.tsv")[0].replace("Glyco_SoybeanNodule_TPD_", "").replace("_19Nov21_21-02-05", ""),
            "gene": ACC[acc], "acc": acc,
            "prsm": row["Prsm ID"], "spectrum": row["Spectrum ID"], "scan": row["Scan(s)"],
            "charge": row["Charge"], "rt": row["Retention time"],
            "precursor_mass": row["Precursor mass"], "adjusted_precursor": row["Adjusted precursor mass"],
            "proteoform_mass": row["Proteoform mass"],
            "first": row["First residue"], "last": row["Last residue"],
            "nterm_form": row["Protein N-terminal form"], "fixed_ptms": row["Fixed PTMs"],
            "n_unexp": row["# Unexpected modifications"], "unexp": unexp,
            "shift": float(m.group(1)) if m else None,
            "span": f"{m.group(2)}-{m.group(3)}" if m else "",
            "frag": row["# Matched fragments"], "masses": row["# Matched masses"],
            "evalue": row["E-value"], "spec_q": row["Spectrum-level Q-value"],
            "prot_q": row["Proteoform-level Q-value"],
            "proteoform": row["Proteoform"],
        })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.to_csv("family_rows.tsv", index=False, sep="\t")
print(f"rows for EKN/100527608: {len(df)}  (0 unexpected: {(df.n_unexp == '0').sum()})")
fam = df[df.shift.notna()].copy()
fam["family"] = ["+317" if abs(s - 317.39) <= 0.05 else
                 ("+316 (1 Da low)" if abs(s - 316.38) <= 0.05 else "other")
                 for s in fam.shift]
print(fam.groupby(["gene", "family"]).size().to_string())
print("\n== +317 rows ==")
cols = ["sample", "gene", "scan", "charge", "first", "last", "nterm_form", "shift", "span",
        "frag", "masses", "evalue", "spec_q"]
print(fam[fam.family == "+317"][cols].sort_values(["gene", "sample"]).to_string(index=False))
print("\n== other residuals on these proteins ==")
print(fam[fam.family == "other"].groupby(["gene", "unexp"]).size().to_string())

"""Normalise all EKN PrSM rows to the mature (initiator-Met-removed) mass basis.

observed = theoretical(reported proteoform) + source residual
residual_mature = residual_source + frame offset
frame offsets: NONE +131.0405 (Met), NME 0, NME_ACETYLATION +42.0106 (acetyl),
M_ACETYLATION +131.0405 - 42.0106 = +89.0299
theoretical(mature) is recovered from the kernel, not by hand.
"""

import json
import subprocess

import pandas as pd

MET = 131.040485  # kernel: mass(1-101 NONE) - mass(2-101 NME)
ACETYL = 42.010565

r = pd.read_csv("ekn_rows_annotated.csv")
r["residual"] = pd.to_numeric(r["Adjusted precursor mass"], errors="coerce") - pd.to_numeric(
    r["Proteoform mass"], errors="coerce")
off = {"NONE": MET, "NME": 0.0, "NME_ACETYLATION": ACETYL, "M_ACETYLATION": MET - ACETYL}
r["frame_offset"] = r["Protein N-terminal form"].map(off)
r["residual_mature"] = r["residual"] + r["frame_offset"]

# classify by the second acyl chain after the fixed N-myristoyl
MYR = 210.198366
def cls(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return "no shift (C-terminal fragment)"
    second = x - MYR
    table = [(238.229666, "N-myr + C16:0 (palmitate)"),
             (262.229700, "N-myr + C18:2 / 2xC16:1"),
             (264.245300, "N-myr + C18:1"),
             (266.261000, "N-myr + C18:0"),
             (252.245300, "N-myr + C17:0 (no library record)")]
    if abs(x) < 0.05:
        return "unmodified"
    for m, label in table:
        if abs(second - m) < 0.02:
            return label
    return f"non-closing ({x:+.2f})"


r["composition"] = [cls(x) for x in r["residual_mature"]]

             .agg(rows=("sample", "size"), samples=("sample", "nunique"),

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["pandas"]
# ///
"""Normalise all EKN PrSM rows to the mature (initiator-Met-removed) mass basis.

Source residual = the numeric value in 'Unexpected modifications'
(the search's residual after its terminal form and named PTMs).
Converting that residual into the mature basis adds the mass the reported
backbone carries relative to the mature backbone:

    NONE              +131.0405 (initiator Met still in the backbone)
    NME                0
    NME_ACETYLATION   +42.0106 (acetyl on the new N-terminus)
    M_ACETYLATION     +173.0511 (Met + acetyl)

Frame masses come from the kernel, not from hand-written tables.
"""

import json
import re
import subprocess

import pandas as pd

seq = ("MGNCGSNPKTNEGPEAVPEPVIEEVKVEQKESSEANVETKLKDQTPNDSEIKSLGTLLNEKVEEAPKTEEVTAE"
       "PKPEEPKTDEVKVQEEKPKAEEAKAET")


def mass(p):
    out = subprocess.run(["tdeasenexus-toolbox", "parse-proforma", "--proforma", p],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return json.loads(out)["result"]["monoisotopicMass"]


FULL, MATURE = mass(seq), mass(seq[1:])
MET = FULL - MATURE
ACETYL = mass("[Acetyl]-" + seq[1:]) - MATURE
OFFSET = {"NONE": MET, "NME": 0.0, "NME_ACETYLATION": ACETYL,
          "M_ACETYLATION": MET + ACETYL}
print(f"kernel frame masses: NONE {FULL:.4f}  NME {MATURE:.4f}  Met {MET:.4f}  acetyl {ACETYL:.4f}")

r = pd.read_csv("ekn_rows_annotated.csv")
r["shift_value"] = [float(re.match(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", s).group(1)) if isinstance(s, str) and re.match(r"[+-]\d", s) else 0.0
                    for s in r["Unexpected modifications"].fillna("")]
r["frame_offset"] = r["Protein N-terminal form"].map(OFFSET)
r["residual_mature"] = r["shift_value"] + r["frame_offset"]

MYR = 210.198366
CLASSES = [(238.229666, "N-myr + C16:0 palmitate"),
           (262.229700, "N-myr + C18:2 (or 2x C16:1)"),
           (264.245300, "N-myr + C18:1 oleate"),
           (266.261000, "N-myr + C18:0 stearate"),
           (252.245300, "N-myr + C17:0 (no library record)")]


def classify(x):
    if abs(x) < 0.05:
        return "no shift"
    second = x - MYR
    for m, label in CLASSES:
        if abs(second - m) < 0.02:
            return label
    return "non-closing"


r["composition"] = [classify(x) for x in r["residual_mature"]]
print("\nrows by composition x frame:")
print(pd.crosstab(r["composition"], r["Protein N-terminal form"]).to_string())
print("\nrows by composition:")
print(r["composition"].value_counts().to_string())
main = r[r.composition == CLASSES[0][1]]
print(f"\nmain class: n={len(main)} samples={main.sample.nunique()} "
      f"median residual {main.residual_mature.median():.4f} "
      f"range {main.residual_mature.min():.4f}..{main.residual_mature.max():.4f} "
      f"sd {main.residual_mature.std():.4f}")
r.to_csv("ekn_rows_basis.csv", index=False)

# per-sample presence of the main lipidated species
print("\nmain-class rows per sample:")
print(main.groupby("sample").size().to_string())

"""Extract the EKN (Q2KMJ4) object rows from the soybean-all TopPIC tables.

Writes ekn_proteoforms.csv (one row per proteoform row in the 10 proteoform
tables) and ekn_prsms.csv (every PrSM row for Q2KMJ4 with spectrum/scan ids).
Reads only; source tables stay untouched.
"""

import csv
import glob
import os

ACCESSIONS = ("Q2KMJ4", "C6T4V4")  # EKN and its uncharacterised N-terminal homolog
RUN = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", ".."))


def read_table(path):
    lines = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    start = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("Data file name"))
    return csv.DictReader(lines[start:], delimiter="\t")


def keep(row):
    acc = row.get("Protein accession", "")
    return any(a in acc for a in ACCESSIONS)


proto_cols = ["data_file", "Prsm ID", "Proteoform ID", "Spectrum ID", "Scan(s)",
              "Retention time", "Charge", "Precursor mass", "Adjusted precursor mass",
              "Feature ID", "Protein accession", "First residue", "Last residue",
              "Previous amino acid", "Next amino acid", "Proteoform",
              "Proteoform mass", "Protein N-terminal form", "Fixed PTMs",
              "# Unexpected modifications", "Unexpected modifications",
              "# Matched masses", "# Matched fragments", "E-value",
              "Spectrum-level Q-value", "Proteoform-level Q-value", "Database protein sequence"]

prsm_cols = ["data_file", "Prsm ID", "Spectrum ID", "Scan(s)", "Retention time",
             "Charge", "Precursor mass", "Adjusted precursor mass", "Proteoform ID",
             "Protein accession", "First residue", "Last residue",
             "Previous amino acid", "Next amino acid", "Proteoform", "Proteoform mass",
             "Protein N-terminal form", "# Unexpected modifications",
             "Unexpected modifications", "# Masses", "# Matched masses",
             "# Matched fragments", "MIScore", "E-value", "Spectrum-level Q-value",
             "Proteoform-level Q-value"]

out_p, out_s = [], []
for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(RUN, "*_ms2_toppic_proteoform.tsv"))):
    for row in read_table(path):
        if keep(row):
            row["data_file"] = os.path.basename(path).split("_ms2_toppic")[0]
            out_p.append({c: row.get(c, "") for c in proto_cols})
for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(RUN, "*_ms2_toppic_prsm.tsv"))):
    for row in read_table(path):
        if keep(row):
            row["data_file"] = os.path.basename(path).split("_ms2_toppic")[0]
            out_s.append({c: row.get(c, "") for c in prsm_cols})


def write(path, rows, cols):
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=cols)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(path, len(rows))


write("ekn_proteoforms.csv", out_p, proto_cols)
write("ekn_prsms.csv", out_s, prsm_cols)

# sequence from the source FASTA
seq = None
with open(os.path.join(RUN, "Glycine.fasta"), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
    hit = False
    for line in fh:
        if line.startswith(">"):
            hit = "Q2KMJ4" in line
        elif hit:
            seq = (seq or "") + line.strip()
print("EKN length", len(seq), "seq", seq)
open("ekn_sequence.txt", "w").write(seq + "\n")

import statistics

rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open("ekn_proteoforms.csv", encoding="utf-8"))
        if "Q2KMJ4" in r["Protein accession"]]


def f(x):
    try:
        return float(x)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return float("nan")


out = []
for r in rows:
    pm, prec = f(r["Proteoform mass"]), f(r["Precursor mass"])
    un = r["Unexpected modifications"] or ""
    shift = float(un.split(":")[0]) if un.startswith(("+", "-")) else 0.0
    bare = pm - shift
    out.append({
        "file": r["data_file"][-3:], "span": f"{r['First residue']}-{r['Last residue']}",
        "nform": r["Protein N-terminal form"], "residual": shift,
        "bare": round(bare, 4), "raw_precursor": prec,
        "raw_delta": round(prec - bare, 4),
        "adjusted_delta": round(f(r["Adjusted precursor mass"]) - bare, 4),
        "charge": r["Charge"], "fragments": r["# Matched fragments"],
        "scan": r["Scan(s)"], "spectrum": r["Spectrum ID"], "q_proteoform": r["Proteoform-level Q-value"],
    })

with open("ekn_basis.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=list(out[0]))
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(out)

none_101 = [o for o in out if o["span"] == "1-101" and o["nform"] == "NONE"]
allnone = [o for o in out if o["nform"] == "NONE" and o["residual"] > 300]
print(f"{'file':>4} {'span':>7} {'nform':>17} {'resid':>10} {'bare':>11} {'raw':>11} {'rawDelta':>9} {'adjDelta':>9} frag")
for o in sorted(out, key=lambda o: (o["nform"], o["span"], o["residual"])):
    print(f"{o['file']:>4} {o['span']:>7} {o['nform']:>17} {o['residual']:>10.4f} {o['bare']:>11.4f} "
          f"{o['raw_precursor']:>11.4f} {o['raw_delta']:>9.4f} {o['adjusted_delta']:>9.4f} {o['fragments']:>4}")

vals = [o["raw_delta"] for o in allnone]
adj = [o["adjusted_delta"] for o in allnone]
print(f"\nNONE-frame +300-family rows: n={len(vals)} raw mean={statistics.mean(vals):.4f} "
      f"sd={statistics.pstdev(vals):.4f} min={min(vals):.4f} max={max(vals):.4f}")
print(f"adjusted mean={statistics.mean(adj):.4f} sd={statistics.pstdev(adj):.4f} "
      f"min={min(adj):.4f} max={max(adj):.4f}")

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Separate genuine discriminators from degenerate ions in the two EKN cards.

A row is a genuine discriminator only when the two models predict materially
different m/z for that ion (|delta| > 0.05 Da).  Rows whose predictions differ
by <0.01 Da are degenerate: a matched/rejected split there is a knife-edge of
the correlation gate, not evidence.  Numbers are read from card cells.
"""

import json


def analyse(path):
    c = json.load(open(path))
    print(f"\n===== {path} =====")
    print("models:", [m["id"] for m in c["models"]])
    print("compositionDeltaDa:", c["verdict"]["compositionDeltaDa"])
    genuine, degenerate = [], []
    for row in c["verdict"]["ions"]:
        cells = row.get("cellsByScan", {}).get("10876") or row.get("cells") or {}
        a, b = cells.get("dual_acyl"), cells.get("mass_at_nterm")
        if not a or not b:
            continue
        d = abs(a["theoreticalMz"] - b["theoreticalMz"])
        entry = (row["label"], row["role"], d, sorted(row["matchedBy"]),
                 a.get("state"), b.get("state"),
                 a.get("errorPpm"), b.get("errorPpm"))
        (genuine if d > 0.05 else degenerate).append(entry)
    print(f"rows: {len(genuine)} genuine (|dmz|>0.05), {len(degenerate)} degenerate")
    print("\n-- genuine discriminators --")
    print(f"{'ion':>8} {'role':<16} {'|dmz|':>9} {'matched':<24} {'dual':<18} {'alt':<18}")
    for lab, role, d, mb, sa, sb, ea, eb in sorted(genuine, key=lambda x: -x[2]):
        print(f"{lab:>8} {role:<16} {d:>9.3f} {','.join(mb):<24} "
              f"{sa+' '+format(ea or 0,'.1f'):<18} {sb+' '+format(eb or 0,'.1f'):<18}")
    print("\n-- degenerate examples --")
    for lab, role, d, mb, sa, sb, ea, eb in sorted(degenerate, key=lambda x: -x[2])[:6]:
        print(f"{lab:>8} {role:<16} {d:>9.5f} {','.join(mb):<24} {sa:<18} {sb:<18}")


for p in ("card_scan11831_shared.json", "card_full_shared.json"):

# /// script

# ///
"""Close the EKN mass balance per source row against the dual-acylation model.

Backbones and the model mass come from `parse-proforma` cells; residuals are
read from the TopPIC rows (ekn_basis.csv).  Nothing here is a measurement of
chemistry: it is the arithmetic that has to close before spectra are read.
"""

import csv
import json
import subprocess

MODEL = ("[Myristoyl]-GN[Palmitoyl]CGSNPKTNEGPEAVPEPVIEEVKVEQKESSEANVETKLK"
         "DQTPNDSEIKSLGTLLNEKVEEAPKTEEVTAEPKPEEPKTDEVKVQEEKPKAEEAKAET")


def mass(proforma):
    out = subprocess.run(["tdeasenexus-toolbox", "parse-proforma", "--proforma", proforma],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return json.loads(out)["result"]["monoisotopicMass"]


model_mass = mass(MODEL)
myr = mass("[Myristoyl]-A") - mass("A")
palm = mass("AC[Palmitoyl]A") - mass("ACA") if False else mass("C[Palmitoyl]") - mass("C")
print(f"model (NME + myristoyl-G1 + palmitoyl-C3) = {model_mass:.5f}")
print(f"myristoyl {myr:.5f}  palmitoyl {palm:.5f}  sum {myr + palm:.5f}")

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("ekn_basis.csv", encoding="utf-8")))
keep = [r for r in rows if float(r["residual"]) > 300 or r["nform"] == "NME_ACETYLATION"]
print(f"\n{'span':>7} {'nform':>17} {'observed':>11} {'bare':>11} {'residual':>10} "
      f"{'model delta':>12} {'diff':>8}")
out = []
for r in keep:
    obs, bare, res = float(r["raw_precursor"]), float(r["bare"]), float(r["residual"])
    # model expectation in this row's frame = model mass - bare of that frame
    expect = model_mass - bare
    out.append({"span": r["span"], "nform": r["nform"], "observed_raw_precursor": obs,
                "bare_backbone": bare, "reported_residual": res,
                "model_residual_in_frame": round(expect, 4),
                "diff_Da": round(res - expect, 4), "file": r["file"]})
    print(f"{r['span']:>7} {r['nform']:>17} {obs:>11.4f} {bare:>11.4f} {res:>10.4f} "
          f"{expect:>12.4f} {res - expect:>+8.4f}")

with open("ekn_mass_balance.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=list(out[0]))
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(out)
print(f"\nwrote ekn_mass_balance.csv ({len(out)} rows)")

"""Same mass balance for the EKN homolog C6T4V4 (100527608).

Arithmetic only: does the dual-acylation model close on the homolog's rows too?
No spectrum is measured here.
"""

import csv
import json
import subprocess

MODEL_RESIDUAL = {"NONE": None, "NME": None, "NME_ACETYLATION": None}


def mass(proforma):
    out = subprocess.run(["tdeasenexus-toolbox", "parse-proforma", "--proforma", proforma],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return json.loads(out)["result"]["monoisotopicMass"]


myr = mass("[Myristoyl]-A") - mass("A")
palm = mass("C[Palmitoyl]") - mass("C")
met = mass("AM") - mass("A")
ace = mass("[Acetyl]-A") - mass("A")
MODEL_RESIDUAL = {"NONE": myr + palm - met, "NME": myr + palm, "NME_ACETYLATION": myr + palm - ace}

rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open("ekn_proteoforms.csv", encoding="utf-8"))
        if "C6T4V4" in r["Protein accession"]]
print(f"{'file':>4} {'span':>7} {'nform':>17} {'span (Da)':>21} {'residual':>10} {'model':>9} {'diff':>8}")

for r in rows:
    try:
        res = float((r["Unexpected modifications"] or "0").split(":")[0])
    except ValueError:
        res = 0.0
    if res < 300:
        continue
    expect = MODEL_RESIDUAL[r["Protein N-terminal form"]]
    kept.append((r["data_file"][-3:], r["First residue"] + "-" + r["Last residue"],

close = [k for k in kept if abs(k[6]) < 0.02]
print(f"\nrows within 0.02 Da of the model: {len(close)} of {len(kept)}")
